te: Thailand–EU FTA and the plant variety protection convention (UPOV 1991): hearing information from government agencies
se: The meeting invited representatives of the Department of Agriculture, the Department of Trade Negotiations and the Department of Intellectual Property to provide information on the Thailand–EU free trade agreement (FTA) negotiations concerning the International Convention for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants of 1991 (UPOV), and approved confirming the appointment of persons to work for the Committee in fiscal year B.E. 2570

te: The blackchin tilapia as assigned by the Senate, soil and water in the Khlong Thom basin, and water problems in Phatthalung
se: The meeting considered the spread of the blackchin tilapia, following a senator’s motion considered by the Senate Ad Hoc Committee on Senate Affairs, took note of the subcommittees’ field visits, and considered a request for budget support for a soil and water conservation project in the Khlong Thom basin, Krabi Province, water management in Phatthalung Province raised through the Senate Meets the People project, and a reply from the Chiang Rai Provincial Land Reform Office
it: The spread of the blackchin tilapia (following a senator's motion)
Progress of the subcommittees: summary of site visits
Request for budget support for a project to prevent soil erosion and conserve water sources, Khlong Thom basin, Krabi Province
Grievances from the Senate Meets the People project, lower south: water management in Phatthalung Province
Confirming the appointment of staff and honorary advisers, fiscal year B.E. 2570
Reply from the Chiang Rai Provincial Land Reform Office: proving rights to occupy land for agriculture

te: Summary of the Andaman fisheries visit, summary of the discussion with the Minister of Agriculture, and matters from residents of the lower south
se: Mr. Wirat Thummabumrong, First Vice-Chair of the Committee, presided over the meeting. The meeting took note of the subcommittees’ work, summarised the study visit on Andaman marine fisheries resources in Krabi and Phang Nga, summarised the discussion with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives and the ministry’s executives on 24 August 2026, scheduled a study visit on water outside irrigation zones in Saraburi and Lop Buri on 17–18 September 2026, and considered proposals from residents of the lower South, such as debt suspension and low-interest loans, and the Narathiwat fishing pier, which is not yet fully used
it: Progress of the subcommittees
Summary of the visit on Andaman marine fishery resources, Krabi and Phang Nga Provinces, 20–22 August 2026
Summary of the discussion with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives and senior ministry officials, 24 August 2026
Study visit on water management outside irrigation zones, Saraburi and Lop Buri Provinces, 17–18 September 2026
Petitions from the Senate Meets the People project, lower South: debt suspension and low-interest loans (soft loans), and the Narathiwat fishing pier

te: Farm water in Chai Nat–Sing Buri, a policy proposal on the blackchin tilapia, and preparing an eastern study visit
se: The water subcommittee reported on information heard from Chai Nat and Sing Buri Provinces on farm water both inside and outside irrigation zones, covering drought and floods, and the livestock subcommittee reported on approaches to preventing rabies. The meeting prepared for the discussion with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives, considered a policy brief on the blackchin tilapia, and a draft schedule for a study visit on agricultural and industrial water management in the East together with a seminar
it: Water outside irrigation zones subcommittee: information from Chai Nat and Sing Buri Provinces
Livestock and fisheries subcommittee: preventing and controlling rabies
Preparing to meet the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives
Policy brief on the spread of the blackchin tilapia
Persons appointed to work for the committee
Study visit on agricultural and industrial water management in the East, and organising a seminar

te: Agricultural technology and research, stray dogs and rabies, and preparation for discussions with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives on 24 August
se: The meeting took note of the work of 3 subcommittees: agricultural technology and innovation, with the National Science and Technology Development Agency (NSTDA) and the National Research Council of Thailand (NRCT) invited to provide information; water management outside irrigation zones; and stray dogs and rabies prevention. It prepared for the discussion with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives on 24 August 2026, prepared the Andaman fisheries study visit, and considered matters from the Senate Meets the People project, upper Central and upper South regions
it: Integrated agriculture subcommittee: agricultural technology and innovation (NSTDA and NRCT invited to give information)
Water outside irrigation zones subcommittee, and livestock and fisheries subcommittee (stray dogs and rabies)
Preparing to meet the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives, 24 August 2026
Preparing a study visit on Andaman marine fishery resources
Additional honorary advisers appointed
Grievances from the Senate Meets the People project, upper central and upper southern regions

te: Summary of the Chiang Mai highland agriculture visit, preparing the Andaman fisheries visit, and petitions on cooperatives
se: The meeting took note of the subcommittees’ progress, summarised the study visit on value-creating highland agriculture in Chiang Mai Province on 23–25 July 2026, considered the schedule for a study visit on Andaman marine fisheries resource management in Krabi, Phang Nga and Phuket on 20–22 August 2026, and considered 2 complaints: hardship from the ministerial regulation on types of cooperatives B.E. 2567, and a request to review a resolution setting the price for reselling land to members, which the complainant considers unfair
it: Progress of the subcommittees
Summary of the visit on value-adding highland agriculture, Chiang Mai Province, 23–25 July 2026
Study visit on managing Andaman marine fisheries resources and the high-value fisheries economy in Krabi, Phang Nga and Phuket, 20–22 August 2026

Complaints: hardship from the ministerial regulation on types of cooperatives B.E. 2567, and a request to review a resolution setting the price for reselling land to members (as stated by the complainant)

te: Preparing a highland agriculture visit, progress of the water subcommittee, and a petition on contaminated water affecting durian orchards in Rayong
se: The meeting prepared for the study visit on value-creating highland agriculture on 23–25 July 2026, took note of the subcommittees’ progress, and considered a letter from farmers in Rayong Province stating that contaminated water, which the complainants believe seeps from an industrial zone in the area, is affecting durian orchards, and asking for an inspection (a claim by the complainants that is still being considered); it also considered appointing honorary advisers and staff for the Committee
it: Preparing a study visit on value-adding highland agriculture, 23–25 July 2026
Progress of the subcommittees (for example, water management outside irrigation zones)
Complaint letter from farmers in Rayong Province: contaminated water that the complainants believe comes from an industrial zone, affecting durian orchards; request for inspection
Honorary advisers and an acting committee secretary appointed
